name: Strength sets
desc: Sets with a rest timer between them.

name: EMOM
desc: Start the work at the top of every minute; rest what is left.

name: E2MOM / E3MOM
desc: Same as EMOM with 2 or 3 minute windows.

name: AMRAP
desc: As many rounds as possible before the clock runs out.

name: For Time
desc: Finish the work as fast as you can, under a cap.

name: Chipper
desc: One long list, done once, technical lifts first.

name: Death By
desc: Add one rep every minute until you cannot finish in the minute.

name: Complex
desc: Several moves back to back without setting the bag down.

name: Density block
desc: Most quality reps in a fixed window.

name: Carry medley
desc: Several carries in a row over set distances.

name: Ruck hybrid
desc: Ruck segments mixed with bag work.

name: Race simulation (HYROX)
desc: Run segments alternating with stations, race order.

name: Benchmark test
desc: A repeatable test to measure progress.

name: Partner (Phase 2)
desc: Split the work with a partner.
